newsitem.title: INDIA: India ITC shrs continue rally, up 7.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: India ITC shrs continue rally, up 7.4 pct.

text.p: Shares of Indian tobacoo major ITC Ltd showed no signs of running out of steam in mid-afternoon trade on Thursday as investors bid in the stock on reports that the firm had notched a sharp rise in first quarter net profit.
ITC shares jumped 35.0 rupees, or 7.41 percent, to 507.25 at the Bombay exchange after gaining over three percent in morning trade, dealers said.
"ITC is leading the rally today," said Sanjay Vaid, chief dealer at Lloyds Securities. "The first quarter reports are having an effect on the price."
The Business Standard newspaper said on Thursday that ITC had reported a 34 percent jump in net profit for the first quarter ending June 30, 1997.
ITC officials were not immediately available for comment.
The stock topped the list of most-actively traded shares at both Bombay bourses. Over 5.15 million shares of the tobacco major were traded at the Bombay exchange in mid-afternoon.
By 1400 hours (0830 GMT), ITC shares gained 32.20 rupees, or 6.80 percent, to 505.20 at the National Stock Exchange with over 16.89 million shares changing hands.
